 The late-blooming love of the "Indian Jones" star and his wife, 22 years his junior.
 (Dan Tri Newspaper) - After more than two decades together, actor Harrison Ford and his wife, actress Calista Flockhart, have maintained a rare bond in Hollywood. Their love story began romantically and has lasted nearly 25 years.
 Báo Dân trí • 22/10/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 A romantic encounter at the Golden Globe Awards. 
 Harrison Ford and Calista Flockhart met at the 2002 Golden Globe Awards, at a time when both had established themselves in Hollywood. Ford was then 59 years old and a veteran star associated with the blockbuster film franchises Star Wars and Indiana Jones . Flockhart (then 37 years old) was famous for her role in the television series Ally McBeal. 
 Harrison Ford and Calista Flockhart met in 2002 and have been in a relationship for nearly 25 years (Photo: Getty).
 Their encounter had the feel of a romantic movie scene. According to international media, the two chatted for about 20 minutes before the incident of wine spilling on each other occurred. Flockhart later revealed that Ford was the one who spilled the wine, contrary to the widely circulated story that she deliberately created the situation to get the actor's attention.
 In an interview with the Extra program in 2025, Ford recalled approaching her to introduce himself, jokingly saying that Flockhart probably didn't even know who he was. Despite being a top star, Ford was still flustered in front of a beautiful woman.
 After that evening, the two artists began dating and soon became the focus of media attention. The couple made their first public appearance together at the Venice Film Festival in Italy in 2002. 
 Harrison Ford and Calista Flockhart met after accidentally spilling wine (Photo: Getty).
 Love transcends age differences. 
 The 22-year age difference made Ford and Flockhart's relationship a topic of discussion from the very beginning. This was also a turbulent period in the actor's life. His second marriage to screenwriter Melissa Mathison had ended. They separated in 2000 and finalized their divorce in 2004.
 Flockhart entered the relationship with a significant responsibility. She had adopted Liam's son in 2001, before meeting Ford.
 When asked about the age difference, Flockhart insisted it didn't affect their relationship. In an interview with People in 2003, she said she sometimes forgot that her partner was 22 years older than her.
 For his part, Ford quickly expressed his seriousness about his new love. In a 2003 interview, the actor happily said, "I'm in love." He believed that romantic love can appear at any stage of life, and expressed gratitude for having found that feeling. 
 Harrison Ford and Calista Flockhart overcame a 22-year age difference to be together (Photo: Getty).
 According to Ford, love isn't just the prerogative of youth. After years in the entertainment industry and experiencing personal ups and downs, the actor is still ready to start a new, serious, and hopeful relationship.
 A Valentine's Day proposal and a new home in New Mexico. 
 You may also like After dating for about seven years, Ford proposed to Flockhart on Valentine's Day in 2009, during a family vacation. It was a significant step in their relationship, which they had kept private from the media.
 In June 2010, they held a private wedding ceremony at the New Mexico governor's mansion in Santa Fe, where Ford was filming the movie Cowboys & Aliens . The governor at the time, a friend of the couple, officiated the ceremony. Liam was also present on his mother's special day. The wedding marked Ford's third marriage and Flockhart's first.
 After the wedding, Ford officially adopted Liam. The actor already had four children from his two previous marriages. This decision shows that the relationship between Ford and Flockhart goes beyond romantic love, encompassing responsibility and a long-term commitment. 
 Harrison Ford adopted Calista Flockhart's son (Photo: JJ).
 In an interview with Us Weekly, Ford shared that Flockhart having children didn't bother him. He already had four children, and Liam was just a toddler when he met him. For him, welcoming another member to the family wasn't an obstacle to their love.
 The woman became the pillar of support for a leading Hollywood star. 
 In March 2015, Ford was involved in a serious plane crash. The actor had to make an emergency landing after the plane malfunctioned, leaving him severely injured and hospitalized.
 In August of the same year, Flockhart described the incident as a difficult and frightening time for the family. She shared that the accident made everyone realize how unpredictable life can be, and that they cherished every moment together even more. Despite experiencing anxiety, the actress continued to support her husband's passion for flying. 
 The event only strengthened the love between Harrison Ford and Calista Flockhart (Photo: Getty).
 That unwavering support partly explains why Ford has repeatedly expressed his gratitude to his wife. At the 2023 Cannes Film Festival, when introducing the film Indiana Jones and the Dial of Destiny , he dedicated special words to Flockhart, thanking her for supporting his passion and dreams. He said his wife had given his life purpose and meaning.
 On screen, Ford is often associated with a strong, independent, and somewhat carefree image. But in matters of the heart, he doesn't hesitate to acknowledge the role of his partner in his journey.
 What's admirable is that the support between the two isn't one-sided. Flockhart also receives respect from her husband in her career and personal choices.
 A relationship of over two decades and their current life. 
 To date, Ford and Flockhart have been together for nearly 25 years, including more than 16 years of marriage. They don't often publicly share private moments, but they still appear together at important events, showing their closeness through simple gestures.
 Last March, the couple attended the Actor Awards in Los Angeles to witness Ford being honored with the Screen Actors Guild-Actors Lifetime Achievement Award (SAG-AFTRA). They held hands on the red carpet and exchanged affectionate gestures. 
 After more than two decades together, Harison Ford and his partner still hold hands affectionately, affirming their enduring love (Photo: Getty).
 You may also like In his acceptance speech, the actor thanked his wife, whom he called "an extraordinarily beautiful wife," and his family for giving him love and courage.
 At 84, Ford continues his artistic career, including a role in the television series Shrinking. He shared that this work allows him more time with his family because he doesn't have to travel far and can return home after each day of filming. For a star who has spent many years working on film sets, that balance is all the more meaningful.
 Flockhart (62 years old) continues to pursue her acting career while maintaining a private life. In her reflections on her marriage, she acknowledges that they have experienced ups and downs like any other couple, but mostly good times. What's important to her is that Ford is always the first person she wants to call when something happens.
 Nearly 25 years after their fateful meeting at the Golden Globes, Harrison Ford and Calista Flockhart haven't cultivated the image of a perfect couple without disagreements. They've chosen to stay together through the changes of age, family responsibilities, careers, and unexpected events.
 Harrison Ford (born 1972) is an American actor and film producer, famous for a career spanning over 60 years. He became a Hollywood cinematic icon thanks to his roles as Han Solo in the Star Wars series and as the archaeologist Indiana Jones in the film series of the same name.
 Before achieving fame, Ford worked as a carpenter to make ends meet and support his family. In 2026, he was awarded the Screen Actors Guild-America Lifetime Achievement Award (SAG-AFTRA) in recognition of his enduring contributions to cinema.
 In terms of net worth, Harrison Ford is estimated to have owned around $300-350 million. The majority of his wealth comes from film earnings, blockbuster deals, and real estate. Besides acting, Ford is also passionate about flying and actively involved in environmental conservation.
